findings.title: The K6 second-order-only mutant is classified by descriptor inequality instead of being executed
evidence: htt/src/common/k6_continuum_oracle.py:168-170 returns only a two-field descriptor for the known mutant.

htt/src/common/k6_continuum_oracle.py:227-231 hard-codes executed=True and sets mutant_killed from mutant['stencil_orders'] != orders; it does not pass a mutant implementation through any registered K6 property.
docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr123_spec.yaml:458-468 requires every frozen mutation to execute and be killed, with any omitted or skipped mutation blocking its lane.
htt/src/common/oracle_lab.py:158-170 consequently counts this descriptor comparison as one executed and killed mutation and can emit aggregate PASS_MECHANICS_C2.
assumptions: Executed means the mutated computation is run on the same frozen fixture and fails at least one preregistered property, not merely that its metadata differs from the clean contract.
findings.consequence: The zero-survivor report and 9/9 executed/killed counts overstate the evidence and violate the spec's fail-closed mutation rule.
findings.required_change: Implement an executable second-order-only/finite-grid-content mutant, run it against the frozen K6 fixtures, record the failed property and metric, and derive executed and mutant_killed from that receipt. Add a negative test that would fail if the descriptor-only shortcut returns.

findings.title: Several registered clean properties are constants, stream counts, or the wrong observable
evidence: htt/src/common/oracle_references.py:230-256 computes clean @ shells for both uniform_flow and zero_shell_response; it never verifies the required uniform-flow normalization against directions, and row_permutation is literal True.
htt/src/common/oracle_references.py:270-280 labels len(plane_clean) == replicates as multiseed_plane_coverage, which proves stream completion rather than plane/component coverage.
htt/src/common/oracle_references.py:296-306 makes pixel_permutation literal True and uses len(alpha_clean) == replicates for multiseed_scale_shift rather than testing a transformed fixture.
htt/src/common/oracle_references.py:346-356 makes label_permutation literal True rather than executing a relabeling invariance test.
docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr123_spec.yaml:458-468 makes every clean property passing a conjunctive acceptance requirement.
assumptions: A named property is evidence only when the corresponding transformation or physical constraint is evaluated and its metric is sensitive to a violating implementation.
A count of completed random streams is not coverage of Fourier planes, scale shifts, or permutations.
findings.consequence: clean_pass_count=9 and the lane PASS statuses are stronger than the executed evidence; regressions in uniform-flow normalization or invariance behavior can remain green.
findings.required_change: Compute uniform-flow response explicitly, execute row/pixel/label permutations on frozen paired fixtures, replace stream-count proxies with preregistered coverage metrics or rename them to completion checks, and add one corruption/negative test per property to demonstrate gate sensitivity.

findings.title: The sqrt(2) residual fixture contradicts its declared iid isotropic-component domain
evidence: htt/src/common/k6_continuum_oracle.py:160-165 sets all three velocity components equal to the same scalar field, producing perfect cross-component correlation.
htt/src/common/k6_continuum_oracle.py:216-224 nevertheless treats agreement with sqrt(2) as a constant-amplitude isotropic-component lock.
htt/src/common/k6_continuum_oracle.py:244 publishes the spec's domain label unchanged.
docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr123_spec.yaml:391-417 declares the domain iid_component_isotropic_stationary_derivatives_constant_amplitude_only.
assumptions: iid components cannot be represented by three identical component fields.
An algebraic coincidence at one perfectly correlated fixture does not establish a covariance-domain expectation.
findings.consequence: The K6 card assigns a stronger stochastic-domain interpretation than the fixture supports, so the registered sqrt2 property is not established as specified.
findings.required_change: Use independent component fields or an analytic covariance reference that actually satisfies the declared domain; preregister an appropriate finite-sample interval when random, and add a correlated/anisotropic challenge that breaks or suspends the lock. Regenerate the K6 card and hashes.

findings.title: The lineage manifest validates field presence and imports, not the specified independence contract
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr123_spec.yaml:164-198 requires equation_or_source_ids, no import or call of mapped production, no shared generated AST/codegen, independently derived expected values, and substantive algorithm-family difference.
scripts/codex_harness/run_pr123_oracle_lab.py:85-101 scans only AST import nodes; it does not inspect calls, symbol/name reuse, code generation, copied expressions, or expected-value derivation.
scripts/codex_harness/run_pr123_oracle_lab.py:170-197 hashes a partial fixture declaration and fills equation_or_source_ids with mutation property_ids rather than equation or source identifiers.
scripts/codex_harness/run_pr123_oracle_lab.py:215-219 converts the import-only check into the broader production_import_scan_clean lineage field.
scripts/codex_harness/run_pr123_oracle_lab.py:240-249 emits production_import_scan_failures=[] and all_rows_valid=True as constants after structural validation.
htt/src/common/oracle_lab.py:174-212 checks non-empty sequences, import-scan boolean, and complexity budgets but does not validate the semantic independence requirements.
assumptions: Property IDs such as uniform_flow or parseval are not equation/source provenance identifiers unless separately bound to immutable source records.
An import-only AST scan cannot justify a field or acceptance statement that says import-or-call.
findings.consequence: G-PR123-ORACLE-INDEPENDENCE and the claim clause that lineage satisfies the independence contract remain unproven even though all_rows_valid is emitted true.
findings.required_change: Register immutable equation/audit/source IDs, bind complete fixture declarations, implement and name the actual import/call/name/codegen checks, derive failure lists and all_rows_valid from those checks, and either prove independent expected-value derivation or narrow the independence claim to the evidence actually collected.

findings.title: PR-157 is recorded as the K6 later production owner even though it is an adjudication-only PR
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr123_spec.yaml:273-289 sets later_production_owner: PR-157 for low_order_curl_stencil.
docs/codex_handoff/pr_backlog.yaml:3653-3660 defines PR-157 as COMMON-owned pre-solver independent finding adjudication.
docs/codex_handoff/pr_backlog.yaml:3705-3735 limits PR-157 to aggregation/adjudication, with diagnostic-only governance scope and no scientific claim.
assumptions: The field name later_production_owner denotes authority to remediate or own a production lane, not merely a downstream adjudicator that consumes its receipt.
findings.consequence: The manifest can blur production ownership with non-author adjudication and invite PR-157 to absorb work outside its registered scope.
findings.required_change: Split later_production_owner from later_adjudication_owner. Keep PR-157 only as adjudicator/consumer, and name a real production remediation PR or explicit blocked/none state for K6.

findings.title: No PR4 access was found in the reviewed patch, but the artifact's zero-command field is declarative rather than authenticated history
evidence: docs/research_program/long_horizon_rescue/pr123_spec.yaml:106-116 correctly forbids all PR4 download, lookup, intake, reduction, and analysis work.
scripts/codex_harness/run_pr123_oracle_lab.py:250-262 and 289-305 write pr4_commands_run=0 and empty inputs as constants.
The reviewed PR-123 implementation and generated-artifact paths contain no PR4 reader, downloader, or empirical consumer.
assumptions: A generated constant can document declared scope for the current process but cannot authenticate complete shell/process history by itself.
findings.consequence: There is no evidence of a PR4 scope violation, but consumers must not treat pr4_commands_run=0 as an independently verified audit receipt.
findings.required_change: Rename or caveat the field as a declared in-process scope receipt, or bind it to a harness command/event ledger if historical authentication is required. Continue to skip all PR4 data work.

findings.statement: The mutation report can false-green a broken clean oracle because several registered properties and every executed flag are asserted rather than measured, and the builder never resolves or validates mutant_symbol. In the shell lane, the property named uniform_flow is computed from the shell-null residual a second time; replacing constrained_shell_weights with all-zero weights still yields clean_passed=true and PASS_MECHANICS_C2 even though W N is zero instead of the identity. row_permutation, pixel_permutation, and label_permutation are also literal True values. Therefore the checked-in 9/9 executed-and-killed summary does not establish the spec's conjunctive clean-property and executed-mutation contract.
assumptions_used: The reviewed spec at lines 118-132 and 458-469 is authoritative.
A clean constrained bulk-flow oracle must satisfy both W N = I and W S = 0.
An executed mutation receipt must be derived from an actual registered callable execution, not a caller-supplied boolean.
counterevidence_refs: The targeted PR-123 suite passes 23/23, but those tests do not exercise the demonstrated false-green path.
reproduction: Monkeypatch common.oracle_references.constrained_shell_weights to return np.zeros((3, len(directions))), then call run_non_k6_reference_cases(root_seed=202607123, replicates=16, ppc_draws=2048). The shell outcome reports status=PASS_MECHANICS_C2, clean_passed=true, and uniform_flow_property=true with clean_shell_max=0.0.
rg shows mutant_symbol is absent from the builder while all nine outcome sites pass executed=True directly.
unresolved: Bind every mutation_registry reference_symbol and mutant_symbol to an exact callable and execution trace; compute W N - I, actual paired permutations, and all other properties from returned values; remove caller-controlled executed booleans from authoritative receipts.

findings.statement: The K6 result does not implement two preregistered acceptance surfaces and its low-order mutation is only a declarative list mismatch. The spec requires separate full-volume, interior, and boundary-collar reporting plus continuum gates. The implementation reports one aggregate manufactured error and a collar-width label, and computes continuum fit fields without any PropertyResult or acceptance threshold. The alleged low-order mutant merely returns {'stencil_orders':[2]} and is marked killed because that list differs from [2,4]; no second-order-only numerical path is run against the same fixtures. Thus PASS_MECHANICS_C2 can be issued without the required boundary decomposition, continuum gate, or numerical mutant execution.
assumptions_used: K6 boundary_reporting and acceptance_and_kill_switches in the reviewed spec are mandatory.
A mutation of the numerical stencil must execute altered numerical behavior on common fixtures to count as killed.
counterevidence_refs: The aggregate manufactured errors exhibit approximately second- and fourth-order convergence, but that does not supply the missing decomposition or a gated continuum criterion.
reproduction: Inspect docs/generated/pr123_k6_continuum_card.json: each boundary order has only boundary_collar_width, manufactured_errors, manufactured_observed_order, solid_body_max_error, and spacings.
Inspect the low_order_curl_stencil outcome: its property IDs omit any continuum gate, and mutant_killed is only second_order_only_summary()['stencil_orders'] != orders.
unresolved: Compute and gate full/interior/collar errors separately; preregister an operational continuum upper-bound criterion; execute a real second-order-only substitution on the identical fields and require its registered failures.

findings.statement: The PPC random-stream evidence violates the frozen seed derivation and does not bind all executed randomness. The spec says streams derive by SeedSequence root then stable registry-index spawn, but PPC creates a separate arithmetic root_seed+991. It records only clean_child even though mutant_child drives the plug-in mutant, and the lineage disclosure says paired inputs are shared although clean and mutant use independent child streams. The seed_ledger_hash therefore cannot reproduce or authenticate the mutant execution it purports to cover.
assumptions_used: seed_contract.derivation and seed_ledger_required are exact provenance requirements.
Every random stream affecting a mutation verdict must appear in the ledger.
counterevidence_refs: The current run is deterministic on this environment, but determinism alone does not make the omitted mutant stream provenance-complete.
reproduction: Count the PPC loop's two SeedSequence children per replicate and compare with the one _seed_record call per replicate.
Trace ppc_children to _rng_children(root_seed + 991, replicates * 2), which is not a child spawn from the frozen root SeedSequence.
unresolved: Allocate all lane streams from one stable root spawn tree, record clean and mutant child identities, and either use common random numbers or correct the paired-input disclosure.

findings.statement: Oracle-independence validation is materially weaker than the declared gate. The scan named production_import_scan_clean inspects import statements only, although the spec requires rejection of imports or calls, generated-code sharing, renamed same algorithms, and non-substantive algorithm-family differences. Complexity is measured only for the tiny reference_symbol, while the 206-line run_non_k6_reference_cases routine owns the fixtures, expected properties, and kill decisions and is excluded from the budget. all_rows_valid is then emitted as literal true. This structure permits the exact tautologies found above while presenting a passing independent-lineage manifest.
assumptions_used: The oracle_lineage_contract hard requirements and fail_closed_on list define the evidence required for G-PR123-ORACLE-INDEPENDENCE.
Code that computes expected properties and kill decisions is part of the oracle complexity and lineage surface.
counterevidence_refs: Manual inspection found no current direct mapped-production import in the reference files; the finding is that the authoritative validator cannot establish the stronger declared facts or prevent regression.
reproduction: Inspect _reference_import_scan_clean: it is only a set-membership check over ast.Import and ast.ImportFrom results.
Compare _function_metrics(reference_path, mutation['reference_symbol']) with the unbudgeted run_non_k6_reference_cases body that constructs every non-K6 verdict.
unresolved: Include evaluator/mutant/fixture code in the complexity and hash surface, statically reject mapped symbol calls and dynamic imports, and replace literal independence booleans with machine-readable checks plus explicit manual adjudication for algorithm-family independence.

findings.statement: The sqrt(2) fixture does not inhabit the domain recorded in the K6 card. The card declares iid-component isotropic stationary derivatives, but _sqrt2_ratio assigns the same scalar field to all three velocity components, making them perfectly correlated. With equal-frequency sine terms, both registered stencils apply the same modified-wavenumber factor, so the ratio is algebraically sqrt(2) even though the stated iid-component covariance was never exercised. The exact lock is therefore a specially constructed identity rather than evidence for the declared residual domain.
assumptions_used: The generated card's sqrt2_domain must describe the actual fixture rather than only the intended analytic argument.
iid vector components exclude three identical component fields.
counterevidence_refs: The constructed field does return sqrt(2) to floating-point precision; the issue is domain mismatch and lack of the preregistered covariance test, not arithmetic output.
reproduction: Inspect _sqrt2_ratio: velocity = np.array((scalar, scalar, scalar)).
The checked-in card reports exactly sqrt(2) for both D2 and D4 despite using different finite-difference formulas, consistent with cancellation of their common modified-wavenumber factor.
unresolved: Use a deterministic orthogonal ensemble or multiseed random gradient-tensor construction whose empirical covariance matches the declared iid/isotropic domain, bind its seed lineage, and gate the ensemble ratio with a preregistered finite-sample tolerance.

findings.statement: The aggregate mutation gate validates only the set of nine mutation IDs and self-reported booleans; it does not bind each outcome to the spec's lane_id, ordered property_ids, mutant_symbol, or an execution receipt. A read-only reproduction constructed all nine IDs with lane_id=WRONG-LANE and property_id=WRONG-PROPERTY and validate_outcomes returned PASS_MECHANICS_C2. The checked-in test itself demonstrates the permissive API by supplying synthetic lane-* names and a generic clean property. Therefore a substituted or unexecuted registered mutant can false-green G-PR123-MUTATIONS.
assumptions_used: The reviewed spec, not a same-function boolean assertion, is authoritative for exact mutation identity and property coverage.
Executed means evidence of invoking the registered mutant symbol on the registered fixture, not a literal executed=True field.
counterevidence_refs: The exact nine mutation IDs are order-checked in build_payloads and missing IDs are rejected.
The current targeted suite passed 23 tests.
reproduction: Construct one make_outcome per FROZEN_MUTATION_IDS using lane_id='WRONG-LANE', one passing PropertyResult('WRONG-PROPERTY', ...), executed=True, and mutant_killed=True.
Call validate_outcomes(rows); observe aggregate_status == 'PASS_MECHANICS_C2'.
unresolved: Require a spec-derived expected map of mutation_id -> lane_id, property_ids, reference_symbol, and mutant_symbol.
Record and validate an execution discriminator or exact per-mutant receipt; add negative tests for lane, property, and mutant substitution.

findings.statement: Several properties in the generated pass receipt are asserted rather than executed. shell_monopole_leak labels clean@shells as both uniform_flow and zero_shell_response, so uniform_flow never measures clean@directions-I; row_permutation, pixel_permutation, and label_permutation are literal True values. K6 no_empirical_consumer trusts empty fields supplied by the same spec and then hardcodes empty report lists instead of binding a repository consumer scan. These rows cannot support the spec's conjunctive every-clean-property pass rule even though today's independent unit examples happen to pass.
assumptions_used: Each registered property_id must have an observed discriminating metric in the generated receipt.
A no-consumer gate needs inventory evidence rather than a self-declared empty list.
counterevidence_refs: tests/contracts/test_pr123_oracle_lab.py directly checks the current shell normalization and shell-null equations.
A targeted rg scan found only PR-123 builder/tests as current K6 consumers.
reproduction: Inspect the generated shell outcome: uniform_flow and zero_shell_response contain the identical metric 3.191891195797325e-16.
Trace both fields to clean_shell_max = max(abs(clean @ shells)); no clean @ directions - I metric is computed in run_non_k6_reference_cases.
Observe literal PropertyResult(..., True, ...) rows for the three permutation properties.
unresolved: Execute and record each permutation invariant and the actual uniform-flow residual.
Generate and hash an allowlisted consumer inventory for the no-empirical-consumer gate.

findings.statement: The PPC stream lineage does not follow the declared SeedSequence_root_then_stable_registry_index_spawn contract. It silently creates a second root at root_seed+991, allocates separate clean and mutant children, and records only the clean child. Reconstructing spawn_key [0] from the declared root yields d5c417... while the receipt contains aa96f6..., which is reproduced only with the undocumented +991 root. The ledger has 16 PPC rows although 32 clean-plus-mutant streams were consumed, so the known mutation execution cannot be replayed from spec plus ledger.
assumptions_used: seed_ledger_required covers every stochastic stream used to establish a clean pass or mutant kill.
The derivation string in the governing spec is normative.
counterevidence_refs: The source hash is included in artifact metadata, so a reviewer who reads code can discover the hidden offset.
All current results are deterministic on this environment.
reproduction: Hash SeedSequence(root_seed).spawn(1)[0].generate_state(4): d5c4173b... .
Hash SeedSequence(root_seed+991).spawn(1)[0].generate_state(4): aa96f62f..., equal to the first PPC ledger row.
Count PPC ledger rows (16) and compare with the 2*16 clean/mutant child streams used.
unresolved: Derive all lane and clean/mutant streams from one registered root via stable registry indices and record role plus entropy/spawn path for every consumed child.
Prefer paired stream semantics where the mutation comparison permits it.

findings.statement: The artifacts are byte-stable but their provenance closure is incomplete. _input_hashes binds only the spec, three source modules, and builder; it never verifies or binds the four role-result files and merged result named and hashed by review_provenance. In addition git_commit_or_worktree_state is a hardcoded 'uncommitted_PR123_patch' string plus the old baseline, so after the required PR commit the same --check can still return current while the recorded worktree state is false. This violates the minimum commit/worktree metadata contract despite exact hashes among generated outputs.
assumptions_used: Referenced review evidence is an input to the reviewed-spec claim and must be present with matching bytes.
git_commit_or_worktree_state must describe generation-time state, not a fixed label.
counterevidence_refs: The spec hash transitively records the expected review-result hashes as text.
The artifact manifest exactly binds the four non-self generated files by byte hash and size.
reproduction: Inspect _input_hashes and observe that no review_provenance path is read or hashed.
Inspect _metadata and observe a constant uncommitted state independent of git HEAD/status.
Run --check: it succeeds based on deterministic bytes without checking those external provenance files or live git state.
unresolved: Verify every review_provenance path against its declared hash during build and include those inputs in the artifact metadata.
Capture a real generation-time HEAD plus dirty-tree digest/status, or define a deliberate commit-independent state field and remove the misleading git-state claim.

findings.statement: The automated oracle-independence gate compares only the top-level reference function's line span with the nonblank size of entire mapped production files, an apples-to-oranges measure that excludes the reference helper closure and includes unrelated production code. It also labels an import-only AST prefix scan as an import/call check even though calls, dynamic imports, and transitive wrappers are not inspected. The current references appear clean under targeted review, but the harness can certify a larger or production-calling self-oracle after trivial indirection.
assumptions_used: Smaller-than-production is intended to cover the executable reference dependency closure against mapped production symbols, not whole-file denominators.
The hard requirement explicitly covers imports and calls.
counterevidence_refs: Targeted rg found no current production consumer/import in the two oracle modules.
Current lineage rows disclose internal process correlation and do not claim external replication.
reproduction: Compare _function_metrics(reference_symbol) against _path_sloc(each entire production path).
Observe that _reference_import_scan_clean consumes only module names returned by ast.Import and ast.ImportFrom and never walks ast.Call targets.
unresolved: Measure a bounded local call/dependency closure on both sides or explicitly narrow the claim to top-level-symbol size only.
Reject direct and resolvable indirect calls to mapped symbols; retain a manual-review caveat for dynamic behavior.
